subject.title: Feature request: configurable announce/connection timeout for gateway

question: Should OpenClaw add new gateway-level lifecycle timeout config, or should the remaining symptoms stay split across narrower existing timeout and diagnostics surfaces?
rationale: The current code has multiple narrower timeout owners, and adding gateway-wide fields would create public configuration semantics across gateway startup, channels, plugins, and A2A delivery.

options.title: Design a gateway timeout policy
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved policy that names which lifecycle phases get gateway-level budgets and how they interact with existing subagent, MCP, handshake, provider, and health-monitor knobs.

options.title: Keep narrower trackers
options.body: Leave this issue open as broad context while resolving A2A announce, plugin-startup diagnostics, and Docker/startup hangs in their narrower canonical issues.

options.title: Reject gateway config expansion
options.body: Close after deciding broad gateway timeout knobs would duplicate existing owners, and ask reporters to file concrete missing diagnostics or hang paths instead.

recommendation.title: Design a gateway timeout policy
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved policy that names which lifecycle phases get gateway-level budgets and how they interact with existing subagent, MCP, handshake, provider, and health-monitor knobs.

likelyOwner.reason: The request spans core config and gateway lifecycle policy, and history shows this person across the central gateway, sessions_send, runtime-startup, and subagent surfaces.
